title: stk reload --json
description: What `stk reload --json` prints on stdout, on success and on failure alike: stk's own verdict on re-reading the policy file into the running `stk serve`. Written from supertoolkit internal/livepolicy/reload.go (`Result.MarshalJSON`): success always carries the three lists, empty rather than absent; failure carries only `ok` and `error`, and the previous policy stays in force. AgentPod's node-agent treats `{"ok": false}` as a result, not an error, and refuses a non-zero exit that claims `ok: true` (stkclient.go, Reload). On failure stk exits non-zero and writes `stk: <message>` to stderr; that text and the exit code are not part of this contract (phase 4, ruling 4).

credentials_kept.description: Removed services whose credential is still stored: a reload deletes none. Omitted when empty.

error.description: Why the reload did not happen, as text.
